item.title: Tour of Southland brings accommodation boost
item.description: Chris Ramsay A rescheduled Tour of Southland has bought a welcome boost to the accommodation sector.

item.title: Solo walkers take steps to help society
item.description: Invercargill men Gareth Davis (left) and Leon Hartnett are taking part in the Southland Relay for Life as individual entrants. PHOTO: GAVIN BOOTH It might be too soon to call Gareth Davis a trendsetter but at least one person is following his example.

item.title: Bumper season expected for cycle trails
item.description: Cyclists on the Around the Mountains Cycle Trail. Southland Cycle trails look like they are heading towards another bumper season.

item.title: Art weaves pathways
item.description: Artist Te’Okota’i Paitai leads a rangaranga (weaving) workshop at He Waka Tuia art gallery in Invercargill this week. PHOTO: NINA TAPU When Te’Okota’i Paitai discovered he was the first person of Pasifika descent to become a William Hodges fellow, he took the long overdue mantle to explore ancestral pathways.

item.title: New gallery centre for all
item.description: The Space art gallery owners Shane and Shig Nicolson (holding baby Anastasia) want to draw the Riverton community together through the use of creative arts. PHOTO: NINA TAPU Opening an art gallery in the Deep South is a dream come true for a North Island couple.

item.title: 'NZ stands with you': Vigil held for landslide victims
item.description: People gather at the site of the community vigil at Coronation Park in Tauranga. Photo: RNZ More than 1000 people have attended a community vigil at Coronation Park in Tauranga this evening in the wake of the Mt Maunganui landslide.
